dialogue_texts: Yukari
The boundaries of this village are fraying at the edges.
Yukari
It seems Yumemura has forgotten how to breathe properly.
Yukari
Is this the manor where the air has turned stagnant?
A guest who speaks of boundaries? How philosophical. But you won't find any gaps to hide in here.
Yukari
I am not looking for a place to hide, but a place to sweep.
Yukari
The glohm is an unsightly stain on the horizon of my kingdom.
Saika
I am Saika Tatsumaru, an admin of the Order.
Saika
If you're the one who bullied my sister Ryuuko...
Saika
You should know that I burn much brighter than her damp scales.
Yukari
A siren who plays with fire? How quaint.
Yukari
But a flame that isolates its master is nothing more than a dying ember. Tell me, is the infected one inside?
Saika
Both Ryuuko and I are the pets of Berenice Grieg.
Saika
Our duty is to protect her and the glohmed maid from uninvited sages.
Saika
This is Order territory - no membership, no entry.
Yukari
The Order is a boundary I define, not a rule I follow.
Yukari
If you won't step aside, I'll have to erase the distinction between you and the ground.
Saika
Then let's see if your reality can withstand the searing truth of my serpentine flame!
